content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a secretary-general position at the Nordic Council of Ministers. Tell about your experience in Nordic cooperation, cultural understanding, and strategic leadership. Also describe how you have strengthened Nordic community and promoted common interests. Length about 400 words.
